I'm glad you're reaching out for support with PTSD, and I want you to know that there are options available even without money or insurance.

Several pathways exist for accessing free or low-cost therapy. You can contact SAMHSA's National Helpline at 1-800-662-4357 for referrals to community-based treatment. Community mental health centers often provide services on a sliding scale or at no cost. NAMI (National Alliance on Mental Illness) offers free support groups and can help connect you with resources. If you're a veteran, the VA provides PTSD treatment. University psychology departments frequently offer low-cost therapy with supervised trainees. Open Path Collective connects people with therapists offering $30-80 sessions. You might also check if you qualify for Medicaid, as eligibility has expanded in many states.

You deserve support, and I encourage you to reach out to one of these resources today to explore what's available in your area.
